name: elalamein-coop-lod0-rec
description: Vanilla El Alamein co-op with the server-side recorder and `aiSettings.lodEnable 0`: every bot at AI LOD 0 with no human, so land hulls are driven by the physics and every shot is real (see dc-el_alamein-coop-lod0-rec). Vanilla ground truth for the Willys, Kubelwagen, Sherman, Panzer IV, Tiger, M10, Priest, Wespe and the planes.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. One or two rounds, then `lab.py stop`.
